(Dissolution) Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 20th September, 2003]
NO.LEGIS.i(21)/74/5602, dated
20-9-2003. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement:----(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Provincial Urban Development Board (Dissolution) (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 14th May, 2002.

[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 20th September, 2003]
NO.LEGIS.i(21)/74/5602, dated
20-9-2003. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 3 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.XVI of the 2002.--- (1) In the North-Vest Frontier
Province Provincial Urban Board (Dissolution) Ordinance, 2002 (N.-W.F.P. Ord.
No.XVI of 2002),---
(i) the existing section 3 shall
be re-numbered as subsection (1) of that section, the full-stop appearing at
the end of subsection (1), as so renumbered, shall be replaced by a colon and
thereafter the following proviso shall be inserted, namely:
"Provided that where the
Board had, before-the-appointed day, acquired any land but the acquisition
proceedings could not be completed by the date the Board stood dissolved,
Government shall be at liberty to--
(a) withdraw from the acquisition
proceedings Where the possession of land has not been obtained; or
(b) restore the land to its
owners where the possession of the land has been obtained, but .the land has
not been utilized for the purposes for which it was acquired or where the
assessment of compensation of the land is found collusive, or based on fraud or
misrepresentation, and any compensation if paid in any such cases to the
landowners, shall be recovered as arrears of land revenue or in such manner as
it may deem proper. "; and
(ii) after subsection. (1), as so
renumbered and amended, the following new subsection (2) shall be added, namely:
"(2) Government shall, by
Notification in the Official Gazette, exercise powers under subsection (1)
notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in any other law for the
time being in force or judgment or order of any Court. ".
